# Securing Your Digital World With Cybersecurity Consulting & Penetration Testing Services

Cyber threats are evolving faster than ever, and businesses of every size are becoming targets. Our
cybersecurity consulting services help companies identify vulnerabilities, strengthen security
infrastructure, and protect critical data from cyber attacks. We work with startups, SaaS companies,
and growing organizations to build strong digital defenses. From penetration testing services to
cloud security consulting, our cybersecurity experts help you stay ahead of emerging threats. These
services include continuous threat monitoring, vulnerability management, and compliance alignment
with frameworks like SOC2 and ISO 27001.

[ Learn More ][37]

# Best IP Intercom System With No Limits & 3 Year Warranty

## What Are IP Intercoms?

All household devices are evolving. Even a conservative market like intercom systems hasn’t been
left behind.

IP intercoms (intercom over IP or internet-based intercom) are intercom systems that harness IP
technology (Internet Protocol technology) allowing users to interface with the building’s local
network over Wi-Fi, opening up a range of security and convenience possibilities.

### Possibilities

Our wired intercom systems are easily connected using Ethernet (Cat5e,Cat6 /UTP5, UTP6), while our
wireless systems utilize Wi-Fi for seamless connectivity. Our intercoms work flawlessly in both
configurations and can be integrated into existing local networks within a building. With BAS-IP,
there are virtually unlimited on the number of door stations, entry panels, or simultaneous calls
within a single system. Programming can be done locally from the intercom monitor or through
specialized BAS-IP software.

### Simplicity

BAS-IP offers nearly limitless options when it comes to building your IP video intercom system. As a
highly specialized company, we focus on expanding our model range, software, and functionality
within a single product group, without venturing into unrelated markets. Our IP intercom systems
come with a wide array of features, which you can explore in detail in our dedicated section.

### High Protection

Our team of experts prioritizes not only convenience and functionality but also the safety,
reliability, and protection of our equipment. All BAS-IP software is developed in-house and
undergoes regular security audits to ensure the highest levels of protection against external
threats.

## Why Is BAS-IP Better

BAS-IP is an esteemed international technology enterprise, specializing in the development and
production of IP video intercom products, access control systems, and communication solutions. Our
robust intercom systems are designed to withstand the elements, making them suitable for outdoor
use.

Established in the UK in 2008, BAS-IP has since grown to employ over 50 talented individuals.

Our premier IP intercoms utilize the SIP protocol, earning us the reputation as a SIP intercom (SIP
intercom system) or VoIP intercom system provider. All our intercom devices are powered via PoE,
making BAS-IP systems genuinely POE intercom systems. Crafted with top-grade materials, our intercom
housing is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use in various weather conditions.

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Published Oct. 30, 2025
[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

## OUR MISSION

To inform the US Government and Critical Infrastructure industries on topics related to Managed
Service Providers (MSP) and Managed Security Service  Providers (MSSP) dedicated to the National
Security mission of maintaining a secure, functioning, and resilient critical infrastructure.

## AS A COLLECTIVE

We desire to collaborate as an industry advisory group to Congress, DoD, the Cyber AB, and state
legislatures to provide insight into the importance of external service providers in securing
critical infrastructure, the federal contracting base, and especially the Defense Industrial Base .

[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-03]

## Standards

As a collective, we believe in identifying minimum requirements for External Service Provider (ESPs)
that exceed the minimum requirements for CUI protection as defined in DFARS 252.204-7012 / NIST SP
800-171.
* A NIST SP 800-53 Tailored Baseline for ESPs
* Suggested changes to standards such as SP 800-171, 800-171A, 800-172 and 800-172A

## Appropriations

We understand that proposals that have been submitted to Congress which include DoD appropriations
for grants to DIB members to offset the necessary one-time investment in getting the DIB to CMMC
compliance. The MSP Collective supports this effort and will continually seek new ways to support
critical infastructure
* Advocate for small businesses in the DIB

[MSPCollective_shapes_Appropriations]
[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-01]

## Certifications

Through involvement in the CyberAB and CMMC program, our collective has encountered several flaws
that require attention to strengthen the DIB and their adjoining atmosphere. **Making sure critical
infrastructure remains:**
* Operational
* Safe
* Resilient

Understanding MSSPs

## What Is an MSSP?

A Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) delivers outsourced security monitoring, threat
detection, and incident response on behalf of your organization. MSSPs operate security operations
centers (SOCs) that provide 24/7 visibility into your environment, so your team doesn't have to
build and staff one internally.

Common MSSP services include SIEM management, managed detection and response (MDR), vulnerability
management, and compliance support. Organizations of [every size][20] engage an MSSP to extend their
security capabilities, reduce response times, or meet regulatory requirements without the cost of a
fully in-house security team.

MSSPs generally offer three service delivery models. In a fully outsourced model, the provider owns
the entire security operations function, from tooling to staffing. A co-managed model splits
responsibilities between your internal team and the MSSP, which works well for organizations that
have some security staff but lack 24/7 coverage or specialized skills. In a hybrid arrangement, the
MSSP handles specific [service areas][21] like threat detection while your team retains ownership of
policy and governance. The right model depends on your headcount, budget, and how much operational
control you want to keep.

In practice, most MSSPs run a dedicated security operations center staffed with tiered analysts who
monitor alerts around the clock. Incoming events from your SIEM, endpoint agents, and network
sensors are correlated and triaged, typically following a workflow where Tier 1 analysts filter
noise, Tier 2 analysts investigate confirmed incidents, and Tier 3 analysts handle escalation and
threat hunting. Response actions range from automated containment to guided remediation steps
delivered to your team. You can explore providers by the specific [security platforms][22] they
support or the [industries][23] they specialize in to find one that aligns with your environment.

## How to Choose an MSSP

### Define Your Requirements

Identify what security services you need: MDR, SIEM management, compliance support, or full SOC
outsourcing. Not sure where to start? Learn [what managed security service providers do][25] and
consider your industry regulations and company size. Document the gaps in your current security
program and rank them by business risk. For example, if you lack after-hours monitoring, 24/7
coverage should be near the top. If you face specific compliance mandates like HIPAA or PCI DSS,
note those early because they will narrow your shortlist. Browse providers by [service category][26]
to see which capabilities are most commonly offered.

2

### Evaluate Capabilities

Look at each provider's technology stack, certifications, SLA guarantees, and industry expertise.
Ensure they support your existing security tools. See our guide to the [best MSSP providers in
2026][27]. Ask whether the MSSP has experience with your specific [security platforms][28], because
onboarding goes faster when the provider already knows your tooling. Verify certifications like SOC
2 Type II, ISO 27001, or industry-specific credentials that demonstrate operational maturity.
Request sample incident reports so you can evaluate how clearly the provider communicates findings
and recommended actions.

3

### Compare & Decide

Request proposals from your shortlist. Compare pricing models, response time SLAs, and references
from similar organizations in your industry. Pay close attention to contract length, termination
clauses, and how pricing scales as your environment grows. Ask each finalist for customer references
in your [industry][29] and at a similar [company size][30], then follow up with those references
about onboarding timelines, alert quality, and how responsive the MSSP is during active incidents.

[Read the full buyer's guide][31]

Budgeting

MSSP pricing varies widely depending on the services included, the size of your environment, and the
level of customization you require. Most providers use one of three pricing models: per-device or
per-endpoint fees, per-user pricing, or flat monthly retainers that bundle a defined set of
services. Some MSSPs also charge based on data ingestion volume, particularly for SIEM management,
which means your log sources and event volume directly affect your monthly bill.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

# Your MSSP for Proactive Security. Resilient Outcomes.

For 27 years, customers have used our managed security-by-design services to move from security as a
defensive IT responsibility to a formalized cyber resilience offensive that mitigates risk and
protects critical assets.

THE SECUREOPS DIFFERENCE

## What Sets SecureOps Apart as a Boutique MSSP

Our experience as a "boutique" managed security services provider (MSSP) with proven, flexible,
security-by-design services goes beyond ordinary. It makes us uniquely qualified to grow your
security maturity and optimize any tools in your cybersecurity tech stack.

Commercial and enterprise companies use our expertise and global managed security services to: 
* Enable 24/7, co-owned MDR and custom SOC operations
* Strengthen their first line of defense with infrastructure security
* Stop threats with vulnerability management

[Learn about our services][3][What makes us different][4]

THAT'S WHY ...

YOUR SIEM. OUR EXPERTISE.

## Co-Owned MDR: Formalize Detection Processes to Speed Response

You bring your SIEM. SecureOps brings 24/7 monitoring, detection, and response to secure your
digital assets. You own the tools. We bring the expertise and coverage. We update your SIEM with the
latest detection rules and threats. Rather than a sunk cost you don’t get back, MDR becomes an
investment in cyber resilience that grows as you scale.

Our goal is to help you develop formalized threat detection rules and content so you get stronger
security from the systems you own. We work to match your business context and security priorities
with our flexible, security-by-design services.

Andrew Morrison

Senior SOC Manager, SecureOps

[Andrew-square]
[Explore Co-Owned MDR][5]

OUTSOURCE WHAT YOU NEED TO EXTEND YOUR TEAM

## Custom SOC Services: 24/7 Monitoring, Detection, and Escalation of True Alerts

Outsource exactly what you want. We'll deliver using your tools and processes. Our
security-by-design services protect your critical data and perimeter with our cybersecurity experts
from Level 1 to Level 3. Add detection engineering for a proactive approach to emerging threats with
a rapid response plan to increase your security maturity.

    Our team of experts provide strategic guidance across a wide range of technologies, and are
deeply committed to our customer’s success. We become an extension of your team, standardize your
processes, and help you build the resilience needed to reduce risk and improve your security
posture.

Patrick Ethier

CTO, SecureOps

[Patrick-square]
[Explore Custom SOC Services][6]
06-ContentMedia

OPTIMIZE THE TOOLS YOU HAVE

## Infrastructure Security Services: Strengthen Your First Line of Defense

Our 24/7 network services address infrastructure security for traditional to Next-Gen Firewalls,
remote access VPN, network segmentation, your implementation of SASE, and more. We troubleshoot,
manage your device configurations, and tune policy to strengthen cyber resilience by reducing your
attack surface.

    We use a lot of automation, but we use it in a controlled way that won’t impact services,
quality, or uptime for your network. Our job is to help you optimize the tools you have—and then
maintain that high performance.

Francois Maddison

Director of Infrastructure Support, SecureOps

[Frank-square]
[Explore Infrastructure Security][7]
06-ContentMedia

MITIGATE RISKS OTHER MSSPs MIGHT MISS

## Vulnerability Management Services: Stop Threats by Eliminating Entry Points

Scanning is a complex process that requires expertise to avoid network failure. We help you
get beyond basic scanning to proactively identify weaknesses and close gaps before they're found.
SecureOps' security experts help strengthen your resilience by identifying all your digital assets
and prioritizing remediation efforts.

    Our VM team provides both immediate and ongoing impact to raise your security status by staying
ahead of threats. Our 26 years of experience in the evolving threat landscape pays off in mitigating
risks other MSSPs might not discover.

Erik Montcalm

Senior VP of Services and Technologies, SecureOps

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

## OUR MISSION

To inform the US Government and Critical Infrastructure industries on topics related to Managed
Service Providers (MSP) and Managed Security Service  Providers (MSSP) dedicated to the National
Security mission of maintaining a secure, functioning, and resilient critical infrastructure.

## AS A COLLECTIVE

We desire to collaborate as an industry advisory group to Congress, DoD, the Cyber AB, and state
legislatures to provide insight into the importance of external service providers in securing
critical infrastructure, the federal contracting base, and especially the Defense Industrial Base .

[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-03]

## Standards

As a collective, we believe in identifying minimum requirements for External Service Provider (ESPs)
that exceed the minimum requirements for CUI protection as defined in DFARS 252.204-7012 / NIST SP
800-171.
* A NIST SP 800-53 Tailored Baseline for ESPs
* Suggested changes to standards such as SP 800-171, 800-171A, 800-172 and 800-172A

## Appropriations

We understand that proposals that have been submitted to Congress which include DoD appropriations
for grants to DIB members to offset the necessary one-time investment in getting the DIB to CMMC
compliance. The MSP Collective supports this effort and will continually seek new ways to support
critical infastructure
* Advocate for small businesses in the DIB

[MSPCollective_shapes_Appropriations]
[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-01]

## Certifications

Through involvement in the CyberAB and CMMC program, our collective has encountered several flaws
that require attention to strengthen the DIB and their adjoining atmosphere. **Making sure critical
infrastructure remains:**
* Operational
* Safe
* Resilient

## Interested in joining the MSP Collective?

## OUR MISSION

To inform the US Government and Critical Infrastructure industries on topics related to Managed
Service Providers (MSP) and Managed Security Service  Providers (MSSP) dedicated to the National
Security mission of maintaining a secure, functioning, and resilient critical infrastructure.

## AS A COLLECTIVE

We desire to collaborate as an industry advisory group to Congress, DoD, the Cyber AB, and state
legislatures to provide insight into the importance of external service providers in securing
critical infrastructure, the federal contracting base, and especially the Defense Industrial Base .

[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-03]

## Standards

As a collective, we believe in identifying minimum requirements for External Service Provider (ESPs)
that exceed the minimum requirements for CUI protection as defined in DFARS 252.204-7012 / NIST SP
800-171.
* A NIST SP 800-53 Tailored Baseline for ESPs
* Suggested changes to standards such as SP 800-171, 800-171A, 800-172 and 800-172A

## Appropriations

We understand that proposals that have been submitted to Congress which include DoD appropriations
for grants to DIB members to offset the necessary one-time investment in getting the DIB to CMMC
compliance. The MSP Collective supports this effort and will continually seek new ways to support
critical infastructure
* Advocate for small businesses in the DIB

[MSPCollective_shapes_Appropriations]

## Certifications

Through involvement in the CyberAB and CMMC program, our collective has encountered several flaws
that require attention to strengthen the DIB and their adjoining atmosphere. **Making sure critical
infrastructure remains:**

Understanding MSSPs

## What Is an MSSP?

A Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) delivers outsourced security monitoring, threat
detection, and incident response on behalf of your organization. MSSPs operate security operations
centers (SOCs) that provide 24/7 visibility into your environment, so your team doesn't have to
build and staff one internally.

Common MSSP services include SIEM management, managed detection and response (MDR), vulnerability
management, and compliance support. Organizations of [every size][20] engage an MSSP to extend their
security capabilities, reduce response times, or meet regulatory requirements without the cost of a
fully in-house security team.

MSSPs generally offer three service delivery models. In a fully outsourced model, the provider owns
the entire security operations function, from tooling to staffing. A co-managed model splits
responsibilities between your internal team and the MSSP, which works well for organizations that
have some security staff but lack 24/7 coverage or specialized skills. In a hybrid arrangement, the
MSSP handles specific [service areas][21] like threat detection while your team retains ownership of
policy and governance. The right model depends on your headcount, budget, and how much operational
control you want to keep.

In practice, most MSSPs run a dedicated security operations center staffed with tiered analysts who
monitor alerts around the clock. Incoming events from your SIEM, endpoint agents, and network
sensors are correlated and triaged, typically following a workflow where Tier 1 analysts filter
noise, Tier 2 analysts investigate confirmed incidents, and Tier 3 analysts handle escalation and
threat hunting. Response actions range from automated containment to guided remediation steps
delivered to your team. You can explore providers by the specific [security platforms][22] they
support or the [industries][23] they specialize in to find one that aligns with your environment.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

### How do I register with the service?

You need to [add your site to Yandex Webmaster][6] and verify the rights to it [using one of the
suggested methods][7]. After that, all the service reports and features will be available to you.

Yandex Webmaster has the [Help][8] where you can find answers or ask the support service a question.

### Can I add more than one site for one Yandex Webmaster account?

You can add multiple sites for one username in Yandex Webmaster. The main condition is to verify the
rights to them.

### Can I share access to my site with another person?

Yes, you can delegate rights to another user. In that case, the user will have access to all the
site data and all the service functions. After that, you can revoke the rights granted to another
user.

### Is everything free in Yandex Webmaster?

Yes, all the service tools and features are absolutely free. You just need to add your site and
verify the rights to it.
